explication: Reicon combines an icon-discovery website with framework-specific icon packages and MCP tooling. A visitor browses or searches icons, opens a detail view to preview styles and copy or download assets, and can consult package guidance or install an integration. The README documents adapters beyond the sampled source; their internal wiring is therefore summarized at package level. MCP components are represented from the tree, with no speculative internal call chain.
